# Welcome {.unnumbered}

This playbook helps **GeoAI engineers, data engineers, and ML practitioners** navigate the day-to-day work of building and deploying geospatial AI at your organization. It is not a tutorial on _how to do GeoAI_ — it is a guide to _how we do GeoAI here_.

::: {.callout-note}
## Companion Playbook
This book is designed to be read alongside the [GeoAI in a Meeting — Decision Maker Playbook](../decision-makers/index.qmd). The strategic decisions made there define the guardrails and priorities you follow in your daily work.
:::

## Who This Book Is For

- **GeoAI / ML Engineers** building and training models
- **Geospatial Data Engineers** building data pipelines
- **Analysts** integrating GeoAI outputs into their workflows
- **MLOps Engineers** deploying and monitoring models in production

## How to Use This Playbook

Each chapter addresses a stage of the GeoAI development lifecycle — from understanding organizational strategy to deploying and monitoring models. Within each chapter you will find:

1. **Context** — how this stage connects to organizational strategy
2. **Procedures** — step-by-step workflows aligned with governance requirements
3. **Code Examples** — working snippets you can adapt (Python-focused)
4. **Checklists** — items to verify before moving to the next stage

## Your Daily Workflow at a Glance

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A[Understand Strategy] --> B[Acquire & Prepare Data]
    B --> C[Develop & Train Model]
    C --> D[Evaluate & Audit]
    D --> E{Governance Review}
    E -->|Approved| F[Deploy & Monitor]
    E -->|Revise| C
    F --> G[Iterate]
    G --> B
```
